summary.intent: Perform a security review of the feat/store-ipns-crypto-data-in-db branch, fix identified vulnerabilities, and get the PR merged with all review comments resolved.
summary.outcome: All HIGH and MEDIUM security findings were fixed (pubKey-to-ipnsName binding check, web app base64 overflow, missing publicKey on publish, server-side validation, DTO MaxLength fixes, protobuf bounds checks), the @cipherbox/crypto package was fixed to support both CJS and ESM consumers, all 8 PR review threads were resolved, and a security review report plus deferred backlog were committed.

repo: @cipherbox/crypto depends on ESM-only packages (@libp2p/crypto, @noble/ed25519, @noble/hashes, ipns) which break NestJS (CJS) consumers when left as external requires
The NestJS API is CommonJS; @cipherbox/crypto must bundle ESM-only deps into its CJS output via tsup noExternal, while keeping ESM output external for Vite/Rollup browser builds
IPNS names are cryptographically derived from the Ed25519 public key via deriveIpnsName(); the client must verify this binding on resolve to prevent key substitution attacks
The web app ipns.service.ts used spread operator for Uint8Array-to-base64 (String.fromCharCode(...bytes)) which crashes on large IPNS records; sdk-core already used a loop-based approach
The web app was not sending publicKey on publish despite the API supporting it, making server-side pubKey-to-ipnsName validation dead code for web-published records

Deferred items are tracked in .planning/DEFERRED.md; security-specific deferred items from this PR include signedRecord validation on write, enforcing signatureVerified=true, and key zeroization convention
The 'Verify API Spec' CI job was missing a build step for @cipherbox/crypto before running pnpm api:generate

code.finding: Must use split config: CJS build with noExternal=[/.*/] to bundle all ESM-only deps inline; ESM build leaves deps external for Vite compatibility. Single config with noExternal breaks desktop/web Vite builds.
pubKey-to-ipnsName binding check added after signature verification: decode pubKey bytes, call deriveIpnsName(), compare to requested ipnsName — prevents server key substitution
Base64 encoding uses loop-based String.fromCharCode (not spread operator) for both recordBytes and publicKeyBytes; publicKey is now derived and sent on publish for both single and batch
Server-side pubKey-to-ipnsName binding validation added: derive IPNS name from submitted publicKey, compare to ipnsName in request, throw BadRequestException on mismatch
Test fixture ipnsName must be the actual IPNS name derived from the test public key, not a dummy string — validation now rejects mismatches
verify-api-spec job needs explicit 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build' step before pnpm api:generate

workflow: Always run a full local API startup check (not just build) before pushing to CI when adding new package dependencies
When tsup bundles ESM-only deps into CJS, verify the resulting ESM output doesn't also bundle them (breaks browser/Vite builds)
Security review findings should be committed to .planning/security/REVIEW-[timestamp].md; deferred items go to .planning/DEFERRED.md
Use gh api graphql for batch-resolving PR review threads; REST for posting replies (in_reply_to requires integer comment ID, not string)

friction: 1Password SSH agent caused intermittent commit signing failures requiring retry

Three separate CI iterations needed to fix @cipherbox/crypto CJS compatibility: first attempt (noExternal for specific packages) missed @noble/ed25519; second attempt (noExternal: [/.*/] globally) broke Vite desktop build; third attempt (split CJS/ESM configs) worked
tsup clean:true on ESM config wiped CJS output — had to sequence builds carefully
CI 'Verify API Spec' job missing dependency build step wasn't caught until after push
open_items: S1: Validate signedRecord CID/sequence against DTO on publish (CodeRabbit comment #5 — deferred to follow-up PR)
S2: Enforce signatureVerified=true once all records in DB include signature data (currently informational only)
S3: Consistent private key zeroization convention across all SDK packages
Refactor repeated Uint8Array-to-base64 loops into a shared bytesToBase64 helper across apps/web/ipns.service.ts, sdk-core/file/index.ts, and sdk-core/folder/index.ts
